column1: # Supported-families certification manifest — full certification on every row.
# Every row runs: load, single-step parity, chain split parity, dtype matrix,
# state handoff, speculative/cache smoke; rows with sweep_period > 0 also run
# the hybrid/recurrent boundary sweep. The KV-cache oracle is the in-run A/B
# assertion carried by the state-handoff lane: --cache-hit-repeats 2 makes the
# cached pass token-exact vs the uncached pass (state_handoff cache_hit_matches).
#   family         | skippy family label used by scripts/family-certify.sh
#   repo           | Hugging Face repo for the cert artifact (highest-download accessible repo per James 2026-08-25)
#   file           | GGUF file (or first shard) inside the repo
#   selector       | quant selector used in model-id
#   sweep_period   | interleave period for boundary sweeps; 0 = no sweep (dense/pure-MoE)
#   layer_end      | final layer for staged correctness lanes
